name: 在倒影里的
description: 在桥间地的某个角落发现了一面奇怪的镜子，映照出不属于自己的身影。完成此任务可解锁主角性别切换功能。
descriptionEn: A strange mirror found in Bridge Crossings reflects a figure that isn't you. Completing this quest unlocks gender switching for the protagonist.
steps: 前往桥间地商业区东北角找到神秘镜子
与镜子互动触发剧情对话
完成镜中世界的战斗挑战
返回与镜子对话完成任务
stepsEn: Find the mysterious mirror in the northeast corner of Bridge Crossings commercial area
Interact with the mirror to trigger a story dialogue
Complete the combat challenge in the mirror world
Return and talk to the mirror to complete the quest

name: 古董店的债务危机
description: 伊波恩古董店入不敷出，需要鉴定师帮忙接取异象委托来还清债务。本任务为城市大亨系统的引导任务。
descriptionEn: Eibon Antique Shop is deep in debt. Help clear the debt by taking on anomaly commissions. This quest serves as the tutorial for the City Tycoon system.
steps: 前往伊波恩古董店与店主对话
触发城市大亨系统教学
stepsEn: Go to Eibon Antique Shop and talk to the shopkeeper
Accept 3 anomaly commission tasks
Complete commissions and report back
Trigger the City Tycoon system tutorial

name: 海特洛市的走失猫咪
description: 海特洛市各处散落着走失的猫咪，帮助居民找回它们可获得好感度和奖励。共需找回10只猫咪。
descriptionEn: Lost cats are scattered throughout Hethereau. Help residents find them for affinity and rewards. Find all 10 cats.
steps: 在新赫兰德居民区接取任务
在城市各处寻找10只走失猫咪
每找到一只与居民对话确认
全部找回后领取最终奖励
stepsEn: Accept the quest at New Herland residential area
Find 10 lost cats around the city
Confirm each cat with the resident
Collect the final reward after finding all 10

name: 午夜飙车族
description: 米格尔区的地下赛车组织向你发起挑战。击败所有对手成为午夜车神。
descriptionEn: An underground racing group in Miguel District challenges you. Defeat all opponents to become the Midnight Racing Champion.
steps: 在米格尔区深夜找到赛车发起人
stepsEn: Find the race organizer in Miguel District at night
Complete 3 racing events
Defeat the final boss opponent
Claim the champion reward

name: 异象委托：幽灵列车
description: 桥间地地铁站出现了幽灵列车异象，乘客被不明力量困在车厢中。前往调查并消除异象。
descriptionEn: A phantom train anomaly has appeared at Bridge Crossings metro station. Passengers are trapped by unknown forces. Investigate and eliminate the anomaly.
steps: 前往桥间地地铁站B3入口
stepsEn: Go to Bridge Crossings metro station B3 entrance
Enter the anomaly space
Clear 3 waves of anomaly monsters
Rescue trapped passengers
Defeat the Phantom Conductor (Boss)

name: 异象委托：镜中迷宫
description: 幻镇的废弃游乐园中出现了镜中迷宫异象，进入者会被困在无限循环的镜面空间中。
descriptionEn: A mirror maze anomaly has appeared in Illusion Town's abandoned amusement park. Entrants are trapped in an infinite loop of mirror spaces.
steps: 前往幻镇废弃游乐园入口
找到进入镜中迷宫的方法
stepsEn: Go to the abandoned amusement park entrance in Illusion Town
Find the way into the Mirror Maze
Solve 3 mirror puzzles
Defeat the anomaly core
Collect anomaly residue

name: 异象委托：时间循环咖啡厅
description: 新赫兰德一家咖啡厅陷入了时间循环异象，店内的顾客和员工不断重复同一天。找到打破循环的方法。
descriptionEn: A cafe in New Herland is trapped in a time loop anomaly. Customers and staff repeat the same day endlessly. Find a way to break the loop.
steps: 在新赫兰德商业街找到异常咖啡厅
与咖啡厅内的NPC对话收集线索
观察时间循环的触发条件
stepsEn: Find the anomaly cafe on New Herland commercial street
Talk to NPCs inside to gather clues
Observe the time loop trigger conditions
Find and eliminate the anomaly source

name: 异象委托：歌唱的下水道
description: 桥间地地下传来诡异的歌声，居民报告有不明生物出没于下水道中。前往调查。
descriptionEn: Eerie singing emanates from beneath Bridge Crossings. Residents report unknown creatures in the sewers. Investigate.
steps: 从桥间地地下水道入口进入
stepsEn: Enter through Bridge Crossings underground sewer entrance
Follow the singing
Defeat the anomaly creatures
Close the anomaly passage

name: 异象委托：消失的画作
description: 新赫兰德美术馆的画作接连消失，被某种异象吞噬。进入画中世界找回失窃的艺术品。
descriptionEn: Paintings are vanishing from New Herland's art gallery, consumed by an anomaly. Enter the painting world to recover the stolen artworks.
stepsEn: Go to New Herland Art Gallery
Investigate the vanished painting locations
Enter the painting anomaly space
Collect 5 stolen paintings
Defeat the anomaly guardian

name: 异象委托：不会停的雨
nameEn: Anomaly Commission: The Rain That Never Stops
description: 未闻浦某区域持续下着不会停的异象之雨，被淋到的物体会逐渐异化。找到雨的源头并制止异象。
descriptionEn: An anomaly rain that never stops has engulfed part of Unheard Shores. Objects touched by the rain gradually mutate. Find the source and stop it.
steps: 前往未闻浦异常降雨区域
使用异能护盾穿越异象雨区
stepsEn: Go to the anomalous rainfall area in Unheard Shores
Use Esper shields to traverse the anomaly rain zone
Defeat the mutated creature horde
Find the rain cloud anomaly core
Eliminate the anomaly core

name: 异象委托：无处电梯
description: 米格尔区一栋公寓的电梯通向不存在的楼层，进入者会迷失在异象空间中。
descriptionEn: An elevator in a Miguel District apartment building leads to non-existent floors. Those who enter become lost in anomaly space.
steps: 在米格尔区找到异常公寓楼
乘坐异象电梯进入异空间
在错乱楼层中找到正确的出口
stepsEn: Find the anomaly apartment building in Miguel District
Take the anomaly elevator into the anomaly space
Find the correct exit among the distorted floors
Close the elevator anomaly passage

name: 异象委托：复制城市
description: 新赫兰德出现了城市区域的完美复制体，异象分身正在侵蚀现实世界。必须在两个世界同时作战。
descriptionEn: A perfect duplicate of a New Herland district has appeared. Anomaly copies are eroding into reality. Fight on both fronts simultaneously.
steps: 发现新赫兰德的复制区域入口
同时处理现实世界和复制世界的异象
关闭两个世界的连接通道
stepsEn: Find the entrance to the duplicate district
Handle anomalies in both real and duplicate worlds
Defeat the anomaly doppelganger boss
Close the connection between worlds

name: 美食鉴定师的挑战
description: 一位自称美食鉴定师的NPC委托你收集海特洛市各地的特色食材，制作独一无二的料理。
descriptionEn: A self-proclaimed gourmet appraiser tasks you with collecting specialty ingredients from across Hethereau to create unique dishes.
steps: 在新赫兰德美食街接取任务
在5个不同区域收集特色食材
stepsEn: Accept the quest at New Herland food street
Collect specialty ingredients from 5 different regions
Return to cook and submit the dish
Unlock the cooking system

name: 载具征用系统的秘密
nameEn: Secrets of the Vehicle Requisition System
description: 米格尔区的地下车库里隐藏着载具征用系统的秘密。解锁更多载具类型和征用权限。
descriptionEn: The underground garages of Miguel District hold secrets of the vehicle requisition system. Unlock more vehicle types and requisition privileges.
steps: 在米格尔区找到隐藏车库入口
解锁高级载具征用权限
stepsEn: Find the hidden garage entrance in Miguel District
Complete the vehicle driving test
Defeat the garage guard
Unlock advanced vehicle requisition privileges

name: 异象委托：倒转的钟塔
description: 幻镇的钟塔出现了时间倒流异象，周围区域的居民记忆正在被侵蚀。必须在时间完全倒转前解决异象。
descriptionEn: A time-reversal anomaly has struck Illusion Town's clock tower. Residents' memories are being eroded. Resolve the anomaly before time fully reverses.
steps: 在倒转时间中找到前进的方法
stepsEn: Go to the Illusion Town clock tower
Find a way forward in reversed time
Solve 3 time puzzles
Reach the top of the clock tower
Defeat the time anomaly core
